name: rexreplace
description: Search & replace across files with a CLI tool that makes you trust what you are doing.
author: Mathias Rangel Wulff

scripts.test: AGENT=1 yarn build && yarn test-cli && yarn test-js && yarn test-fuzzy
scripts.postbuild: cp bin/rexreplace.cli.node.js bin/rexreplace.cli.node.min.js && cp bin/rexreplace.cli.bun.js bin/rexreplace.cli.bun.min.js
scripts.version: yarn build-minify && yarn sync-version && git add npm/rexreplace-bun/package.json
scripts.test-minify: AGENT=1 yarn build-minify && yarn test-cli && yarn test-js
scripts.test-cli: yarn test-cli-global && yarn test-cli-node && yarn test-cli-bun
scripts.test-ci: yarn test-format && yarn build && yarn test-cli && yarn test-js && yarn test-minify
scripts.rebase: yarn is-git-clean && git fetch && git rebase origin/main
scripts.test-format: prettier . --list-different || (echo 'Please correct file formatting using `yarn format` and try again.' && exit 1)
scripts.is-git-clean: (git diff --quiet --exit-code --cached && git diff --quiet --exit-code) || (echo Please commit or stash changes && exit 1)
scripts.prerelease: yarn is-git-clean && yarn test && yarn test-minify && yarn load-options
scripts.postrelease: npm publish && npm publish ./npm/rexreplace-bun && git push && git push --tags && echo "Successfully released version $npm_package_version" && (open https://github.com/mathiasrw/rexreplace/releases || 1)
